target_moa.text: Difelikefalin is a selective, full kappa opioid receptor (KOR) agonist with no agonist activity at mu or delta opioid receptors; KOR activation on peripheral sensory neurons and immune cells reduces itch. The relevance of KOR activation to therapeutic effectiveness is not known.

citations.quote: Difelikefalin is a selective and full agonist at the kappa opioid receptors (KORs), with minimal identified off-target activity.

In vitro, difelikefalin selectively binds to and activates the human KOR with a Ki of 0.32 nM and an EC50 of 0.16 nM, with no agonist activity for human mu or delta opioid receptors at concentrations up to 10 µM.
Difelikefalin is a new-molecular-entity small synthetic peptide that, when injected intravenously, activates kappa opioid receptors on peripheral sensory neurons and immune cells.
KORSUVA is a kappa opioid receptor (KOR) agonist. The relevance of KOR activation to therapeutic effectiveness is not known.

modality.text: Peptide (small synthetic peptide, kappa opioid receptor agonist)

citations.quote: The drug substance, difelikefalin is a small synthetic peptide and kappa opioid receptor (KOR) agonist.
